chunks: From al-Bazzani from al-Rida (peace be upon him) who said:
A boy is taken to task over prayer when he is seven years old, and a woman does not cover her hair from him until he begins to have nocturnal emissions.

key_terms.يَحْتَلِمَ: He experiences nocturnal emissions (sign of puberty)

ai.seo_question: At what age does a boy begin to be trained for prayer according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Faqih highlights the foundational age of seven for initiating boys in prayer, a practice rooted in the Prophetic tradition of gradual religious education. It further clarifies the legal status of a woman's hair as awrah relative to the boy's pubescence (bulugh), indicating that the strict covering requirements are linked to his transition to adulthood rather than a fixed age. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on distinguishing between the stages of childhood (sibkh) and maturity (bulugh) in determining ritual obligations.
